cost_analysis.method: Exact all-cash round-trip product at frozen entry/exit references; no search over entry, exit, lookback or threshold.
cost_analysis.break_even: Solve closed form for per-side fee at fixed slip15bps and per-side slip at fixed fee25bps; validate zero-PnL root against frozen execution engine.

fixed_adverse_case.meaning: one additional 5bps slippage per side over the prior stress profile; dates and prices fixed

concentration_analysis.rank: Positive trades ranked by net percentage return, descending; tie by entry timestamp.
concentration_analysis.omission: Skip the entire selected frozen position episode, keep cash, then compound subsequent original entries at their same times. Recompute the complete equity path and drawdown.
concentration_analysis.classification: Ex-post missed-best-trades stress exercise, not an implementable signal, probability forecast or independently selected strategy.
concentration_analysis.independent_check: Product of remaining actual trade factors must match the replayed final cash; never subtract original USDT winners from final PnL.
